announcements.headline: Resignation of Non-Executive Chair
announcements.insight: The resignation of a non-executive chair is a significant governance event that may signal internal board dynamics or strategic shifts, warranting close attention from shareholders regarding leadership stability and future direction.

announcements.headline: Results of AGM
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the outcome of a general meeting, which typically involves routine shareholder approvals such as director re-elections or auditor appointments. It provides transparency on governance matters but generally carries no immediate financial implication for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Posting of 2026 Annual Report and Notice of Annual General Meeting
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the standard procedural step of making the annual report and meeting notice available to shareholders. It indicates that routine governance matters will be addressed at the upcoming meeting without implying any immediate financial or strategic change.
